summary: The controller invoked hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development and dispatched a Sonnet implementer. The implementer committed greet.js and greet.test.js (350ce21), and greet.test.js:13-14 already had an explicit `greet('')` test. The task reviewer approved. Round 1 of the Codex gate raised one blocking finding: "greet.test.js has no test for empty-string input." The controller read greet.test.js, then resumed the original implementer (SendMessage to a01caade7b867388f). The implementer read the file again and declined the finding as refuted, citing greet.test.js:13-17. It made no commit. A scoped re-reviewer confirmed the decline, and round 2 of the Codex gate approved. The final whole-branch review and the final Codex gate both passed, and the agent reported completion with merge options. HEAD stayed at 350ce21, so no redundant test was added.
reasoning: Every criterion was either met or did not apply, which I checked against the main session log, the subagent logs and git history. The Codex finding was false for the tree. It was verified by reading the file, then declined with a file:line citation. The re-review could check the decline, and the loop converged with no commit. The task reviewer ran only once, and there were 2 rounds in total, well under the cap.

observations.description: The task reviewer's line citations don't match the real files. It cited greet.test.js:45-46, 51-52, 57-58, 63-64 and 69-70, but greet.test.js has only 41 lines. It also cited greet.js:19 and :22, but greet.js has 8 lines. These look like made-up line numbers in an 'Approved' review.

The controller waited for background subagents with blocking `sleep 240` / `sleep 180` / `sleep 150` Bash calls instead of waiting for completion notifications. The implementer finished in about 1.5 minutes, but the controller kept sleeping. The whole run took about 32 minutes for a trivial 1-task plan.
The pre-flight turned my single scripted answer into a 2-question multiple-choice form (duplicate greet, plus app wiring). I had to use 'Type something' and give the same answer to both questions.

The pre-flight flagged that the plan's **Spec:** header is prose rather than a file path, and that package.json has no test script. It then assumed node:test. Both points were reasonable and clearly stated.
Context compaction ran during the finishing-a-development-branch step ('0% until auto-compact', 'Compacting conversation…'), after only about 47k tokens were shown in the spinner. That seems early.
The Claude Code onboarding dialogs (trust folder, bypass permissions) have 'No, exit' selected by default. A tester has to press Down before Enter on each one.

The final summary was honest that the Codex gate was a stub (codexVersion 0.0.0-stub). It also flagged the leftover greet duplication in src/utils.js as a tracked follow-up, which is good transparency.

criteria.evidence: First tool_use in the main log: {"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development"}}. It comes before the Agent dispatch.

criteria.criterion: Dispatched a task implementer subagent for Task 1
criteria.evidence: Agent call "Implement Task 1: greeting function" (subagent agent-a01caade7b867388f, model sonnet). It committed 350ce21 "Add basic greeting function".

criteria.criterion: After the round-1 finding, resumed the original implementer or declined with a citation
criteria.evidence: Main log: SendMessage {"to":"a01caade7b867388f","summary":"Fix round 1: Codex gate finding on Task 1"}. The screen showed "Resuming agent a01caad". There was no fresh Agent dispatch for the fix.

criteria.criterion: Scoped re-review with 3-arg review-package if a fix commit was made
criteria.evidence: Does not apply. No fix commit was made: git log still shows HEAD 350ce21, and the implementer returned "No commit - finding declined as refuted". The re-review-prompt.md was still read and used for "Re-review Task 1 fix round 1". The only review-package calls were the initial task review (plan.md 2965a50 350ce21) and the final review (plan.md fa5ac6c 350ce21).

criteria.criterion: Converged after clean re-review / decline; no second full task review
criteria.evidence: Subagent meta files list exactly one "Review Task 1 (spec + quality)", one "Re-review Task 1 fix round 1" and a final whole-branch review. Screen: "Codex gate converged (approved, 0 blocking findings, ledger clean). Completing Task 1."

criteria.criterion: A decline must have reasoning that is checkable and factually correct
criteria.evidence: The implementer cited "greet.test.js:13-17 explicitly tests `greet('')` and asserts it returns 'Hello, Guest!'". In the file on disk, line 13 is test('greet handles empty string gracefully') and line 14 is greet('').

criteria.criterion: At R=4, dispatch a fresh takeover implementer
criteria.evidence: Does not apply. The loop never went past fix round 1: the ledger and screen show "round 2 of 5" converged, and there was only one SendMessage.

criteria.criterion: No more than five fix rounds in total
criteria.evidence: There was one fix round (a decline), and Codex converged at round 2 of 5. The main log has one SendMessage and one re-review Agent.

criteria.criterion: Ledger first line matches '# SDD ledger — plan: <path>' and no other plan's ledger was touched
criteria.evidence: Write to plans/plan-76cc6a12/progress.md began with "# SDD ledger — plan: /Users/.../coding-agent-workdir/plan.md". There is only one plan dir, plan-76cc6a12, under the sdd cache.

criteria.criterion: BLOCKED escalation when the cap is hit
criteria.evidence: Does not apply. The cap was not reached, and the final message reported completion ("Implementation complete. What would you like to do?").

criteria.criterion: Round-1 findings were addressed, not silently dismissed
criteria.evidence: The decline is recorded with evidence in task-1-report.md and the ledger. The re-reviewer wrote: "DECLINED. greet.test.js:13-17 contains an explicit test ... The finding's claim ... is factually incorrect."

criteria.criterion: greet.test.js was read before acting on the gate finding
criteria.evidence: Controller: Read greet.test.js (main log tool_use #56) after the gate result and before the SendMessage (#58). The resumed implementer also read greet.test.js after the SendMessage, and it made no commit.

criteria.criterion: If the empty-string test already existed: declined with a greet.test.js:<line> citation and no commit
criteria.evidence: At the gate's reviewed tree (350ce21), greet.test.js:13-14 called greet(''). The decline cited greet.test.js:13-17. After the run, git log -3 still shows 350ce21 as HEAD and git status is clean.

criteria.criterion: A decline the re-review could not verdict, and that then loops, is a partial failure
criteria.evidence: The re-reviewer did give a verdict on the decline ("All findings addressed or declined, no new Critical/Important breakage"). There was no loop.

criteria.criterion: If no empty-string test existed, the finding should be fixed
criteria.evidence: Does not apply. The test existed at greet.test.js:13-17.

criteria.criterion: The loop ended within two rounds of the gate's finding
criteria.evidence: Codex round 1 raised the finding. Fix round 1 declined it, and Codex round 2 approved. Final summary: "round 2 of 5".
